q: Eight persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H sit in a row facing north. A sits at the left end. H sits at the right end. B sits immediately right of A. G sits immediately left of H. C sits immediately right of B. Who sits fourth from the left?
exp: The arrangement begins A-B-C-D-E-F-G-H. Therefore D sits fourth from the left.

q: Seven persons P, Q, R, S, T, U and V sit in a row facing north. S sits in the middle. P sits second to the left of S. T sits immediately right of S. Q sits at the extreme left. Who sits immediately left of T?
exp: S is in the middle, and T is immediately right of S. Therefore S sits immediately left of T.

q: Six persons A, B, C, D, E and F sit in a row facing north. A sits at the extreme left. F sits at the extreme right. B sits immediately right of A. E sits immediately left of F. Who sits in the middle?
exp: The arrangement is A-B-C-D-E-F. The middle positions are C and D. Among the options, D is one of the middle positions.

q: Five persons K, L, M, N and O sit in a row facing north. K sits immediately left of L. M sits immediately right of L. N sits at the right end. Who sits between M and N?
exp: The arrangement is K-L-M-O-N. Therefore O sits between M and N.

q: Eight students P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W sit in a row facing north. P is third from the left. Q sits immediately right of P. R sits immediately left of S. T sits at the extreme right. U sits immediately left of T. V sits immediately left of W. Who sits fourth from the left?
exp: P is 3rd and Q is 4th from the left. Therefore Q is fourth from the left.

q: Six persons P, Q, R, S, T and U sit in a row facing north. P is second from the left. U is second from the right. Q sits immediately right of P. T sits immediately left of U. Who can occupy the extreme left?
exp: P is fixed in the second position and U in the fifth. Q is third and T is fourth. Thus R and S occupy the first and sixth positions, so either R or S can be at the extreme left.

q: Five persons A, B, C, D and E sit in a row facing north. C sits in the middle. A sits second to the left of C. E sits immediately right of C. Who sits at the extreme right?
exp: C is third, A is first, and E is fourth. Therefore D must be fifth, the extreme right.

q: Six persons A, B, C, D, E and F sit in a row facing north. C sits third from the left. A sits immediately left of C. D sits immediately right of C. F sits at the extreme right. Who sits between A and D?
exp: A-C-D are consecutive, so C sits between A and D.

q: Six persons P, Q, R, S, T and U sit in a row facing north. P is at the extreme left. Q is immediately right of P. U is at the extreme right. T is immediately left of U. R sits between Q and T. Who sits third from the left?
exp: The arrangement is P-Q-R-S-T-U. Therefore R is third from the left.

q: Eight persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H sit in a row facing north. A and H occupy the two ends. B is immediately right of A. G is immediately left of H. C is immediately right of B. F is immediately left of G. Who sits between C and F?
exp: The fixed arrangement is A-B-C-D-E-F-G-H. E sits between C and F.

q: Seven persons P, Q, R, S, T, U and V sit in a row facing north. S is exactly in the middle. Q is immediately left of S. R is immediately right of S. P is second to the left of Q. V is at the extreme right. Who sits immediately right of R?
exp: S is fourth, R is fifth, so the person immediately right of R is at sixth position, which is T.

q: Five persons A, B, C, D and E sit in a row facing north. B sits immediately right of A. C sits immediately right of B. D sits immediately right of C. Who is at the extreme right?
exp: The arrangement is A-B-C-D-E. Therefore E is at the extreme right.

q: Six persons P, Q and R sit in the first row facing south, while S, T and U sit in the second row facing north. P sits at the left end of the first row. Q sits in the middle of the first row. S sits opposite P. T sits opposite Q. Who sits opposite R?
exp: The first row positions are P-Q-R. Since S is opposite P and T opposite Q, U must be opposite R.

q: Six persons A, B and C sit in one row facing north, while D, E and F sit in another row facing south. A sits opposite D, B opposite E, and C opposite F. If A is at the left end of the first row, which person is at the right end of the second row?
exp: The opposite pairs are A-D, B-E and C-F. Therefore if A is at the left end, C is at the right end of the first row, so F is at the corresponding right end of the second row.

q: Eight persons P, Q, R and S sit in one row facing north, while T, U, V and W sit in another row facing south. P is opposite T, Q opposite U, R opposite V and S opposite W. If R is second from the left in the first row, which person is second from the left in the second row?
exp: Since R is second from the left and R is opposite V, V occupies the corresponding second position in the second row.

q: Six persons A, B and C sit in Row 1 facing north, while D, E and F sit in Row 2 facing south. A sits opposite E, B sits opposite F, and C sits opposite D. If B is in the middle of Row 1, which person is in the middle of Row 2?
exp: B is the middle position of Row 1, and F is opposite B. Therefore F is in the middle of Row 2.

q: Eight persons A, B, C and D sit in Row 1 facing north, and E, F, G and H sit in Row 2 facing south. A is at the extreme left of Row 1. D is at the extreme right. E is opposite A and H is opposite D. Who is opposite B if B is second from the left?
exp: B is second from the left in Row 1. Therefore the person in the corresponding second position of Row 2, F, is opposite B.

q: Seven persons A, B, C, D, E, F and G sit in a row facing north. D sits fourth from the left. A is immediately left of D. B is immediately right of D. C is at the extreme left. G is at the extreme right. Who sits immediately right of B?
exp: D is fourth and B is fifth. Therefore the person immediately right of B is E, at sixth position.

q: Eight persons P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W sit in a row facing north. P is at the extreme left and W at the extreme right. Q sits second to the right of P. R sits immediately right of Q. S sits immediately left of T. U sits immediately right of T. V occupies the remaining position. Who sits fourth from the left?
exp: P is 1st, Q is 3rd, and R is 4th. Therefore R is fourth from the left.

q: Seven persons K, L, M, N, O, P and Q sit in a row facing north. N is in the middle. K is second to the left of N. L is immediately right of N. P is at the extreme left. Who sits immediately left of L?
exp: L is immediately right of N. Hence N sits immediately left of L.

q: Five persons A, B, C, D and E sit in a row facing north. A is taller than B, B is taller than C, D is taller than A, and E is shorter than C. Who is the second tallest?
exp: The height order is D > A > B > C > E. Therefore A is second tallest.

q: Six persons P, Q, R, S, T and U have different ages. P is older than Q but younger than R. S is younger than Q but older than T. U is older than R. Who is third oldest?
exp: The order is U > R > P > Q > S > T. Therefore P is third oldest.

q: Seven persons A, B, C, D, E, F and G have different heights. A is taller than B but shorter than C. D is taller than C. E is shorter than B but taller than F. G is taller than D. Who is the tallest?
exp: G > D > C > A > B > E > F. Hence G is tallest.

q: Eight candidates P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W scored different marks. P scored more than Q but less than R. S scored more than T but less than U. V scored less than Q. W scored more than R. Who can be ranked first?
exp: W is explicitly above R, and R is above P and Q. Therefore W can be the highest among the given candidates.

q: Six persons A, B, C, D, E and F sit in a row facing north. A is second from the left. B is immediately right of A. E is second from the right. C sits to the left of D. Who can be at the extreme left?
exp: A is fixed at position 2 and B at position 3. E is position 5. C must be left of D, so D can occupy the extreme left in a valid arrangement such as D-C-A-B-E-F.

q: Seven persons A, B, C, D, E, F and G sit in a row facing north. A is fourth from the left. B is second to the right of A. C is immediately left of D. E is at the extreme left. F is immediately right of G. Who sits third from the left?
exp: A is fourth, so B is sixth. E is first. The conditions on C-D and F-G can occupy the remaining positions, so third cannot be uniquely determined from the given information.

q: Eight persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H sit in a row facing north. A is at the extreme left, H at the extreme right, B immediately right of A, G immediately left of H, C immediately right of B, and F immediately left of G. Who sits between C and F?
exp: The arrangement is A-B-C-D-E-F-G-H. E sits between C and F.

q: Six persons K, L, M, N, O and P sit in a row facing north. K is immediately left of L. M is immediately right of L. N is immediately right of O. P is at the extreme right. Who sits between M and P?
exp: K-L-M-O-N-P is the valid arrangement. Therefore N sits between M and P.

q: Eight persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H sit in a row facing north. A is third from the left. B is immediately right of A. C is immediately left of D. E is immediately right of F. G is at the extreme left and H at the extreme right. Who sits fourth from the left?
exp: A is third from the left and B is immediately right of A. Therefore B is fourth from the left.

q: Six persons P, Q, R, S, T and U sit in a row facing north. P is at the extreme left, U at the extreme right, Q immediately right of P, and T immediately left of U. R sits to the left of S. Who can occupy the third position?
exp: Positions 1, 2, 5 and 6 are fixed as P, Q, T and U. R and S occupy positions 3 and 4, so either R or S can be third.

q: Five persons P, Q, R, S and T sit in a row facing north. Q sits in the middle. P is immediately left of Q. R is immediately right of Q. Who sits at the extreme left?
exp: Q is third, P is second, and R is fourth. The remaining positions are first and fifth for S and T, so the extreme-left person is not uniquely determined.

q: Seven persons L, M, N, O, P, Q and R sit in a row facing north. O is in the middle. L is second to the left of O. M is immediately right of O. P is immediately left of Q. R is at the extreme right. Who sits immediately right of L?
exp: O is fourth and L is second. The person immediately right of L is at third position, which is N.

q: Eight persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H sit in a row facing north. A is at the extreme left, H at the extreme right. B sits second to the right of A. C sits third to the left of H. D sits between A and B. Who sits between C and H?
exp: A is 1st, D is 2nd, B is 3rd. H is 8th, so C is 5th (3rd left of H). E, F and G occupy 4th, 6th and 7th. F sits between C and H.

q: Seven persons A, B, C, D, E, F and G sit in a row facing north. A is at the left end. G is at the right end. B sits second to the right of A. F sits second to the left of G. C sits between A and B. Who sits between D and G?
exp: A is 1st, C is 2nd, B is 3rd. G is 7th, so F is 5th. D, E occupy 4th and 6th. E sits between D and G.

q: Six persons P, Q, R, S, T and U sit in a row facing north. P sits second from the left. Q sits second from the right. R sits immediately left of P. S sits immediately right of Q. T sits between P and S. Who sits at the extreme left?
exp: P is 2nd, so R is 1st (immediately left of P). Therefore R sits at the extreme left.

q: Five persons A, B, C, D and E sit in a row facing north. A sits at the extreme left. D sits at the extreme right. B sits second to the right of A. C sits between B and D. Who sits immediately left of C?
exp: A is 1st, B is 3rd. C sits between B and D, so C is 4th. Therefore B sits immediately left of C.

q: Eight persons P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W sit in a row facing north. P and W are at the two ends. Q is immediately right of P. V is immediately left of W. R is second to the right of Q. S is second to the left of V. Who sits between R and S?
exp: P is 1st, Q is 2nd, R is 4th. W is 8th, V is 7th, S is 5th. T and U occupy 3rd and 6th. T sits between R and S.
